changes.reason: Fresh Minduck profiles select the bundled ordinary default duck (minduck-duck), with the user-optimized work SVG. Existing profile choices and explicit model/voice setup are preserved. Fresh installs explicitly enable the desktop window as well as the pet World, automatically showing the bundled default duck. Existing explicit visibility and figure choices remain untouched.

Request microphone access only when voice input is enabled. Allow two explicit Matter actions from the guarded pet renderer and forward them to the embedding host callback. Matter task output is received through the authenticated native bridge as normalized public text, separate from business credentials and the original figure. Each capsule supports a bounded conversation/turn target through guarded native IPC; hover/focus uses the system-theme Matter brand outline.

Shared random idle thinking effect; source SVG and original thought-bubble keyframes retained without replacing figures. Shared action recovery retains interrupted work/ask until landing or dizzy recovery completes, without editing figure packs. Compose the automatic Matter activity controller inside the existing opaque figure sandbox; preserve manual flow recovery and idle thinking.

Shared idle thought-bubble effect and direct short-click trigger. The persistent thoughtShown preference does not block the effect; the click replaces poke bounce/jump while preserving drag and original figure artwork. Stationary business states and pending action recovery suppress idle/click thinking. Automatic Matter activity, including terminal expressions, suppresses idle and click thinking.

Support an optional reaction:false release flag that skips only the short-click poke bounce/jump. Pointer capture, drag/drop/throw physics and touch notification remain unchanged. Accumulate pet strokes only for continuous on-body pointer motion, never for pointer entry. Business state locks and success/failure expressions stop current walking; only idle can roam. The configured roaming preference and drag physics are preserved. Expose read-only active expression and gesture names so automatic transitions wait for actual animation completion rather than manifest guesses.
